item.tib: a bse brag btsan dmar po'i bskang ba
item.coloph: sgo yi btsun pa dar ma rgyal mtshan bdag go yi cho rog gi srib lung na sgom zhing yod tsa na/ sprel lo lug zla'i tshes dgu'i dgong ka phar ngos kyi brag rtsar bsdad tsa/ skyes phran bzhin bzang ba cig rta sngon gcig bcib nas byung / bstan pa srung bar khas blangs/ rang rtags srog snying dam pa phul/ phra cig tsam dgon du/ shes rab 'od zer gyis bskul nas yi ger btab/ sprul sku dar ma rgyal mtshan la/ shes rab bla ma des dbal sa dgos (dgon) la a khom ston pa'i zhus so/ phyis sprul sku dar ma rgyal mtshan dngos la/ a khom bstan pas mjal nas rtsa dar bcad lung zhus/ sgo dbye rjes gnong dang chas zhus so/ a khom do skyal ba'i drung nas rim par brgyud pa'o//
